purpose: The freeze-v3 receipt pins the exact source that authorized it. Freeze v3 could run a scientific job but its own independent verifier then rejected the completed run over a host clock step, so freeze v4 had to narrow that verifier and rebuild the 006 mechanics gate that binds its hash. Those edits change files the v3 receipt binds, so v3 can no longer be rebuilt from the working tree. Every divergence is declared here with the frozen hash and a location the frozen bytes are still recoverable from, so the v3 provenance chain and its retained failure stay complete and auditable.

divergences.reason: Removes the wall-clock ordering clause from the journal chain invariant. RB-WP14R-003 makes the monotonic clock the authority and keeps UTC as provenance only, but the verifier enforced UTC monotonicity as a hard chain rule. A 1.846 s Windows NTP step inside a retained attempt therefore made a completed, otherwise clean run permanently unverifiable. observedUtc is still parsed so malformed stamps are rejected, and monotonicElapsedMs remains a hard invariant. Paired regression tests pin both directions.

Adds wp14r-resilient-development-v4 to FREEZE_MODULES so the protocol can select the builder that owns a v4 receipt. Selection stays safe because the selected builder rebuilds the whole receipt from source and compares it.

rebuiltMechanicsGate.reason: validate_mechanics_gate_provenance compares the current verifier source against the 006 fixture receipt, so narrowing the verifier required rebuilding that gate. All 15 mutation classes are still caught.
